simple.meaning: שָׁגַג (shâgag) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to stray , i.e. (figuratively) sin (with more or less apology).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Leviticus, Numbers, Job, Psalms, beginning at Leviticus 5:18. Its contexts include flock, offering, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁגַג (H7683).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

firstOccurrence.englishText: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

majorEvents.evidenceText: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

timeline.evidenceText: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.
The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.
With him is strength and wisdom.
Before I was afflicted, I went astray;

definitions.full: H7683. shagag [ שָׁגַג ] verb go astray, commit sin or error (|| שׁוג שׁגה, ); — Qal Perfect שָׁגָג֛ Lev 5:18 ; Participle שֹׁגֵג Job 12:16 ; Psa 119:67 ; feminine שֹׁגֶ֫גֶת Num 15:23 ; — 1 err,. mentally Job 12:16 . 2 sin ignorantly, inadvertently, Lev 5:18 ; Num 15:28 (P), compare Psa 119:67 . — בְּשַׁגָּם Gen 6:3 perhaps Infinitive construct suffix, by reason of their going astray , see Ges § 67p Ew Dr and others; > Vrss for that he also is flesh. אֲבִישַׁג .
